Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath
About
Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath is the third boss you will encounter in your jorney.
Lore of Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath

"Arion, once a simple Illager from ancient times, became a great soldier during the Armageddon War. A Formidable strategist and warrior, he transcended his humble status by defeating numerous Ancient Builders, therefore seizing the mystical power of the emeralds. Impressed by his strength and cunning, his peers appointed him as the Emerald Keeper, bestowing upon him ancient artifacts to perfect his mastery. He was even named Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath by his mates. And now, Arion guards this power, with ambitions matched only by his thirst for domination."
Recicpe
You can summon the Arion, Tyrant of the Emerald Wrath by using Emerald Totem
As of v6.3 crafting the Emerald Totem requires using the Create mod
Defeating it rewards you with three special items and unlocks the ability to mine emerald and use emerald tools, armor, and weapons.
